src/NetworkManager.cpp.reason: The two `#if SIMUT_NET_CYW43` are the chip's guards, not the class's: the include of pico/cyw43_arch.h, and the one call into the CYW43's control code this file makes outside the framework's WiFi class, cyw43_arch_enable_sta_mode( ) in startScan( ), which a build for board = rpipico cannot link (2026-09-26 study). Both leave with the radio's state machine, when it moves into its own unit in src/net/.

NetworkManager.cpp is still the CYW43's driver: the join and the reconnect ladder, both scanners, the setup access point, the signal level and the address getters are WiFi.* calls here (the wired build has its own states in NetworkManager_Wired.cpp). Ends when the radio's state machine moves into src/net/ and NetworkManager asks it, as it asks the wired link.

src/AppManager_Air.cpp.reason: The Air (hibernation) exists only with the CYW43: the rule air-needs-cyw43 of tools/features.toml and an #error in simut_config.h refuse it with any other driver. airEnterDormant( ) powers the radio down before every sleep: WiFi.disconnect(true), WiFi.end( ), and then WL_REG_ON (GP23) by hand. The include of pico/cyw43_arch.h has no call behind it in this file today. Ends when the Air asks the CYW43 driver in src/net/ to power down.
